reno-wards.caveats: City of Reno hosted "Reno 6 Ward Map" (AGO item a36d7af2b3824a15a5d95207cf4d5803, adopted Option E, last edited 2024-01-30). Rep field is stale ("To be determined by 2024 election") so member names were kept only where populated. Cross-checked against Washoe County OpenData layer 122 (six wards with current members). Under 300 KB, not simplified. Validation note: 770 W Golden Valley Rd (39.6105,-119.8420) hits Ward 4; both the City of Reno City Limits layer (CityofRenoBoundaries/5) and Washoe County OpenData layer 11 place that point inside Reno city limits, so the address is not unincorporated per official data. Raw city-limits helper saved at raw/reno-city-limits.geojson.

sparks-wards.caveats: Published by Washoe County OpenData, not by City of Sparks (no Sparks GIS host resolved). Under 300 KB, not simplified.
